jobs.name: Cookie health checker
jobs.prompt: Run /opt/data/scripts/camofox_cookie_check.py and review the JSON output. If any account shows alert NOT equal to "ok", send the user a summary listing account, domain, alert, cookie_name, expires_at, and the recommended action: re-export fresh cookies for that account. If all accounts are ok, say everything is healthy and no action is needed.
